response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with a CS degree and genuine depth in testing culture, developer tooling, and one high-throughput environment (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec in D). However, the resume shows no evidence of the core domain this role is built around: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical/causal analysis. Scope also appears mostly team-level (Senior/Staff at small-to-mid companies) rather than the multi-workstream, cross-org influence expected at Principal/IC6 in an enterprise-scale organization. Reasonable candidate for a senior full-stack or developer-tooling role; a stretch for this specific growth/experimentation principal position unless a screen reveals unlisted experimentation and org-level leadership experience.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on across many stacks, with CS degree and real low-latency, high-QPS service experience
Strong engineering-fundamentals culture: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based dev, own testing frameworks, mentoring and workshops
Platform/tooling builder mindset — open-source GIS platform, test runners, MCP code generators for AI-agent workflows
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, feature-flighting, guardrail metrics, or bias/rollout-risk experience
No telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis track record; data aptitude unproven
Scope and influence read as Senior/Staff at smaller companies, below Principal/IC6 multi-team, enterprise-scale expectations

key_factors.factor: Seniority and cross-org scope gap vs. Principal/IC6
Breadth of engineering experience and platform/tooling building
